name: Udder
author: stappmus
description: See all your Herdr agents from the Omarchy bar, get notified when one finishes while you are away, and jump straight back to it.

barWidget.description: See all your local Herdr agents, get notified when one finishes while Herdr is out of sight, and jump straight back to it.

schema.label: Register Herdr event bridge
schema.description: Register Udder's event-only Herdr companion so completion alerts need no background polling.

schema.label: Play Herdr completion sound
schema.description: Play Herdr's completion chime once when Udder posts a finished-agent notification.

schema.label: Open panel refresh (seconds)
schema.description: Udder requests snapshots at this interval only while its overview is open.

schema.label: Client check interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often Udder cheaply reads Linux socket metadata to notice that a Herdr client attached.
